summary: A Depth subscription on an NFO future: Shoonya's depth snapshot (dk) gives a Depth frame with the quote, OI and the five-level book; a partial (df) moves the best levels and the OI; a book of zeros clears every level; the unsubscribe releases the depth subscription.

notes: Noren sends OI as oi and toi, and each member reads it as its web adapter does (audit FB-07): Shoonya streams toi as open_interest. The partial carries an oi change without toi to show which one is read.
Circuits, the 52-week range and depth_level go out in Depth frames as the web sends them.
